RESULT.markdown:
# Quenlow Meterworks Ltd — Dossier

## WHO
Quenlow Meterworks Ltd was founded by Tessa Arkwright and provides sub-meter reading and tenant utility billing services to residential landlords across the United Kingdom (company-disclosed). Audited FY2024 accounts report an average of 73 employees during the financial year (regulatory-filed).

## WHEN
Founded in 2016 (company-disclosed). Most recent audited accounts cover FY2024 (regulatory-filed). Harrowden Utilities Journal reported in April 2025 that the largest-client framework agreement had been renewed (journalist-reported).

## WHERE
Founded in Leeds; the company serves residential landlords across the United Kingdom (company-disclosed). A current headquarters location is not separately disclosed in the evidence pack.

## WHY
Demand is driven by the 2023 Metered Tenancy Charges Code, which pushes landlords toward itemised tenant utility billing; a Harrowden Utilities Journal analysis names Quenlow among the beneficiaries (journalist-reported).

## HOW
The service model combines sub-meter reading and tenant billing. Company-stated, unaudited operating metrics from February 2025: 1,140 landlord clients and approximately 210,000 meter readings per quarter. Audited FY2024 revenue was GBP 8.9 million with profit before tax of GBP 1.1 million (regulatory-filed). Corvane Data records no external equity funding and classifies the company as bootstrapped (database).

## INTERRELATIONS
The billing engine integrates with the Rentholm, Casaverd, and Trellick PM property-management platforms (company-disclosed). The largest client is housing group Pellonby Estates under a renewed five-year framework agreement, journalist-estimated at roughly 18% of revenue; Quenlow declined to confirm the percentage (journalist-reported).

## VIABILITY — 74/100
Rubric strengths: revenue quality and audited profitability — GBP 1.1 million profit before tax on GBP 8.9 million of audited FY2024 revenue (regulatory-filed); funding independence — no external equity rounds recorded, database-classified as bootstrapped; regulatory tailwind — journalist-reported demand driven by the 2023 Metered Tenancy Charges Code. Principal rubric risk: customer concentration — the Pellonby Estates relationship is journalist-estimated at roughly 18% of revenue, a figure the company declined to confirm. Funding amount and valuation were not treated as positive inputs. Score: 74.

The audited FY2024 accounts state an average of 73 employees during the financial year.

In its February 2025 portfolio update, Quenlow stated it serves 1,140 landlord clients and performs approximately 210,000 meter readings per quarter, describing both as internal, unaudited operating metrics.

Harrowden Utilities Journal reported in April 2025 that Quenlow renewed a five-year framework agreement with its largest client, housing group Pellonby Estates, journalist-estimated at roughly 18% of revenue and unconfirmed by the company.
Corvane Data records no external equity funding rounds for Quenlow Meterworks Ltd and classifies the company as bootstrapped.

Quarrow Ledger, which sells back-office and weighbridge-ticket reconciliation software to quarry and aggregates operators, has closed a Series A round led by Bramfield Capital Partners. Neither the company nor the investor disclosed terms of the transaction.

Quarrow Ledger was started in Leeds in 2019 by Priya Ramanathan and Callum Wexford, both former finance managers at aggregates operators. The company builds bookkeeping and haulage-invoice automation designed specifically for quarry workflows.

More than 40 quarry and aggregates operators across the UK and Ireland run their month-end close on Quarrow Ledger, according to the company. Featured case studies include Dunmarsh Aggregates and Kellbrook Stone.

# Quarrow Ledger Ltd - Dossier

## WHO
Founded by Priya Ramanathan and Callum Wexford, former finance managers at aggregates operators (company-stated). Lead investor: Bramfield Capital Partners.

## WHEN
Incorporated 2019 (registry-filed). Series A closed in 2025 per trade press coverage.

## WHERE
Registered office and operating base in Leeds, England; customer base across the UK and Ireland.

## WHY
Quarry and aggregates operators run month-end close on generic tooling; Quarrow Ledger captures that back-office spend with quarry-specific bookkeeping, weighbridge-ticket reconciliation, and haulage-invoice automation.

## HOW
Vertical SaaS sold directly to operators; company states more than 40 UK and Ireland operators run month-end close on the platform (company-stated, not independently verified).

## INTERRELATIONS
Bramfield Capital Partners led the Series A with participation from existing angels; Quarrow Ledger raised a $12 million Series A round. Featured customers include Dunmarsh Aggregates and Kellbrook Stone.

## VIABILITY
Score: 58/100. Real niche demand and named customers support viability, but revenue, headcount, and audited accounts are undisclosed (small-company audit exemption), capping the score under the rubric.

evidence.excerpt: Kernwatch's Q2 2026 services roundup profiles four regional operators. Managing director Ilse Kravenne said the rename reflects the firm's shift toward export-controls compliance work.
